what: Vertical-stack budgets for biomes/veiledmountains (rmwzq1pa88m7q): 5 station HTML pages (< 2.2 MB each via veiledmountains.tex.veiledmountains.js sidecar), max samplers < 15, and estimated VRAM <= 380 MB.

veiledmountains.html.why: Station 1 (hall): Hoh-scale stilt-root nurse-log cathedral, 12 m giant tree-ferns, mire spore-spikes & crimson crown epiphytes with sidecar textures.

veiledmountains-gorge.html.why: Station 2 (gorge): Sol-Cleft 2-tier mossy megabreccia cataract, wedged KSPAN nurse-logs, split-cedar footbridge & Z3 epiphyte cloud-slope.

veiledmountains-kanopi.html.why: Station 3 (kanopi): 95 m tilted Ancient Kanopi circular canopy-oculus ruin (KRUINS.watch) pouring a 65 m waterfall into a lily-and-moss tarn.

veiledmountains-veilpass.html.why: Station 4 (veilpass): Glacial U-trough, braided boulder torrent, lime-green slide-alder avalanche chutes & KSTACKS megabreccia crag spires.

veiledmountains-southvale.html.why: Station 5 (southvale): Perpetual-fog Hush-Edge cushion-moss boulder moraine labyrinth, writhing cloud-oaks & sunken red-peat trail.

*.why: Shared veiledmountains.tex.veiledmountains.js texture sidecar pack serving all five Veiled Mountains station pages.
